```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Variant_Calling_Benchmark/"))
set.seed(0)

require("ggplot2")
require("cowplot")
require("viridis")
require("reshape2")
require("dplyr")
require("tidyverse")
library(plotly)
library(Rtsne)
library(stringr)
library(ggbeeswarm)

library(DSS)

source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

library(data.table)
```

```{r import metrics}
fread("deepvariant_qc_metrics/deepvariant_qc.dp_counts.tsv") -> dp_counts
fread("deepvariant_qc_metrics/deepvariant_qc.gq_counts.tsv") -> gq_counts
fread("deepvariant_qc_metrics/deepvariant_qc.vaf_bins.tsv") -> vaf_bins
fread("deepvariant_qc_metrics/deepvariant_qc.filter_counts.tsv") -> filter_counts
fread("deepvariant_qc_metrics/deepvariant_qc.sample_summary.tsv") -> sample_summary

dp_counts$method <- str_replace(dp_counts$method, "Founders-surjected-chr-sort", "Pangenome")
gq_counts$method <- str_replace(gq_counts$method, "Founders-surjected-chr-sort", "Pangenome")
vaf_bins$method <- str_replace(vaf_bins$method, "Founders-surjected-chr-sort", "Pangenome")
filter_counts$method <- str_replace(filter_counts$method, "Founders-surjected-chr-sort", "Pangenome")
sample_summary$method <- str_replace(sample_summary$method, "Founders-surjected-chr-sort", "Pangenome")

dp_counts <- merge(
  dp_counts,
  sample_summary[, .(sample, method, median_dp)],
  by = c("sample", "method"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

dp_counts[, normalized_dp := dp / median_dp]
```

```{r}
# define metric thresholds
gq_threshold <- 20
normalized_dp_threshold_lower <- 0.5
normalized_dp_threshold_upper <- 1.5
vaf_threshold <- 0.3
```

```{r visualize metric distributions, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}


filter_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
filter_counts[, method := factor(method)]
filter_counts[, filter := factor(filter)]

gq_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
gq_counts[, method := factor(method)]

dp_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
dp_counts[, method := factor(method)]

vaf_bins[, sample := factor(sample)]
vaf_bins[, method := factor(method)]

method_colors <- c(
  "bwa" = "#0072B2",
  "Pangenome" = "#D55E00"
)

gq_bin_width <- 1
dp_bin_width <- 2
normalized_dp_bin_width <- 0.075
vaf_bin_width <- 0.04

filter_plot_dt <- filter_counts[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(method, filter)]

gq_plot_dt <- copy(gq_counts)
gq_plot_dt[gq >= 60, gq := 60]
gq_plot_dt[, gq_bin := floor(gq / gq_bin_width) * gq_bin_width]
gq_plot_dt[gq_bin >= 60, gq_bin := 60]
gq_plot_dt <- gq_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(method, gq_bin)]

dp_plot_dt <- copy(dp_counts)
dp_plot_dt[dp >= 120, dp := 120]
dp_plot_dt[, dp_bin := floor(dp / dp_bin_width) * dp_bin_width]
dp_plot_dt[dp_bin >= 120, dp_bin := 120]
dp_plot_dt <- dp_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(method, dp_bin)]

dpNormalized_plot_dt <- copy(dp_counts)
dpNormalized_plot_dt[normalized_dp >= 4, normalized_dp := 4]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[, normalized_dp_bin := floor(normalized_dp / normalized_dp_bin_width) * normalized_dp_bin_width]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[normalized_dp_bin >= 4, normalized_dp_bin := 4]
dpNormalized_plot_dt <- dpNormalized_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(method, normalized_dp_bin)]

vaf_plot_dt <- copy(vaf_bins)
vaf_plot_dt[bin_mid >= 1, bin_mid := 1]
vaf_plot_dt[, vaf_bin := floor(bin_mid / vaf_bin_width) * vaf_bin_width]
vaf_plot_dt[vaf_bin >= 1, vaf_bin := 1]
vaf_plot_dt <- vaf_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(method, vaf_bin)]

p_filter <- ggplot(filter_plot_dt, aes(x = filter, y = count/1e6, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  xlab("FILTER") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("FILTER counts") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

p_filter

p_gq <- ggplot(gq_plot_dt, aes(x = gq_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.45, width = gq_bin_width) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  xlab("GQ (60 = >=60)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("GQ distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = gq_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_gq

p_dp <- ggplot(dp_plot_dt, aes(x = dp_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.45, width = dp_bin_width) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  xlab("DP (120 = >=120)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("DP distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

p_dp

p_dpNormalized <- ggplot(dpNormalized_plot_dt, aes(x = normalized_dp_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.45, width = normalized_dp_bin_width) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  xlab("Normalized DP (4 = >=4)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("Normalized DP distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = normalized_dp_threshold_lower, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = normalized_dp_threshold_upper, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_dpNormalized

p_vaf <- ggplot(vaf_plot_dt, aes(x = vaf_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "identity", alpha = 0.45, width = vaf_bin_width) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
  xlab("VAF") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("VAF distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vaf_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_vaf
```

```{r visualize metric distributions with overlap, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

filter_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
filter_counts[, method := factor(method)]
filter_counts[, filter := factor(filter)]

gq_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
gq_counts[, method := factor(method)]

dp_counts[, sample := factor(sample)]
dp_counts[, method := factor(method)]

vaf_bins[, sample := factor(sample)]
vaf_bins[, method := factor(method)]

component_colors <- c(
  "overlap" = "grey75",
  "bwa" = "#0072B2",
  "Pangenome" = "#D55E00"
)

gq_bin_width <- 1
dp_bin_width <- 2
normalized_dp_bin_width <- 0.075
vaf_bin_width <- 0.04

filter_plot_dt <- filter_counts[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(filter, method)]
filter_plot_dt <- dcast(filter_plot_dt, filter ~ method, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

if (!"bwa" %in% names(filter_plot_dt)) {
  filter_plot_dt[, bwa := 0]
}
if (!"Pangenome" %in% names(filter_plot_dt)) {
  filter_plot_dt[, Pangenome := 0]
}

filter_plot_dt[, overlap := pmin(bwa, Pangenome)]
filter_plot_dt[, bwa := pmax(bwa - Pangenome, 0)]
filter_plot_dt[, Pangenome := pmax(Pangenome - overlap, 0)]

filter_plot_dt <- melt(
  filter_plot_dt,
  id.vars = "filter",
  measure.vars = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"),
  variable.name = "component",
  value.name = "count"
)

filter_plot_dt[, component := factor(component, levels = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"))]

gq_plot_dt <- copy(gq_counts)
gq_plot_dt[gq >= 60, gq := 60]
gq_plot_dt[, gq_bin := floor(gq / gq_bin_width) * gq_bin_width]
gq_plot_dt[gq_bin >= 60, gq_bin := 60]
gq_plot_dt <- gq_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(gq_bin, method)]
gq_plot_dt <- dcast(gq_plot_dt, gq_bin ~ method, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

if (!"bwa" %in% names(gq_plot_dt)) {
  gq_plot_dt[, bwa := 0]
}
if (!"Pangenome" %in% names(gq_plot_dt)) {
  gq_plot_dt[, Pangenome := 0]
}

gq_plot_dt[, overlap := pmin(bwa, Pangenome)]
gq_plot_dt[, bwa := pmax(bwa - Pangenome, 0)]
gq_plot_dt[, Pangenome := pmax(Pangenome - overlap, 0)]

gq_plot_dt <- melt(
  gq_plot_dt,
  id.vars = "gq_bin",
  measure.vars = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"),
  variable.name = "component",
  value.name = "count"
)

gq_plot_dt[, component := factor(component, levels = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"))]

dp_plot_dt <- copy(dp_counts)
dp_plot_dt[dp >= 120, dp := 120]
dp_plot_dt[, dp_bin := floor(dp / dp_bin_width) * dp_bin_width]
dp_plot_dt[dp_bin >= 120, dp_bin := 120]
dp_plot_dt <- dp_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(dp_bin, method)]
dp_plot_dt <- dcast(dp_plot_dt, dp_bin ~ method, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

if (!"bwa" %in% names(dp_plot_dt)) {
  dp_plot_dt[, bwa := 0]
}
if (!"Pangenome" %in% names(dp_plot_dt)) {
  dp_plot_dt[, Pangenome := 0]
}

dp_plot_dt[, overlap := pmin(bwa, Pangenome)]
dp_plot_dt[, bwa := pmax(bwa - Pangenome, 0)]
dp_plot_dt[, Pangenome := pmax(Pangenome - overlap, 0)]

dp_plot_dt <- melt(
  dp_plot_dt,
  id.vars = "dp_bin",
  measure.vars = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"),
  variable.name = "component",
  value.name = "count"
)

dp_plot_dt[, component := factor(component, levels = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"))]

dpNormalized_plot_dt <- copy(dp_counts)
dpNormalized_plot_dt[normalized_dp >= 4, normalized_dp := 4]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[, normalized_dp_bin := floor(normalized_dp / normalized_dp_bin_width) * normalized_dp_bin_width]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[normalized_dp_bin >= 4, normalized_dp_bin := 4]
dpNormalized_plot_dt <- dpNormalized_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(normalized_dp_bin, method)]
dpNormalized_plot_dt <- dcast(dpNormalized_plot_dt, normalized_dp_bin ~ method, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

if (!"bwa" %in% names(dpNormalized_plot_dt)) {
  dpNormalized_plot_dt[, bwa := 0]
}
if (!"Pangenome" %in% names(dpNormalized_plot_dt)) {
  dpNormalized_plot_dt[, Pangenome := 0]
}

dpNormalized_plot_dt[, overlap := pmin(bwa, Pangenome)]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[, bwa := pmax(bwa - Pangenome, 0)]
dpNormalized_plot_dt[, Pangenome := pmax(Pangenome - overlap, 0)]

dpNormalized_plot_dt <- melt(
  dpNormalized_plot_dt,
  id.vars = "normalized_dp_bin",
  measure.vars = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"),
  variable.name = "component",
  value.name = "count"
)

dpNormalized_plot_dt[, component := factor(component, levels = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"))]

vaf_plot_dt <- copy(vaf_bins)
vaf_plot_dt[bin_mid >= 1, bin_mid := 1]
vaf_plot_dt[, vaf_bin := floor(bin_mid / vaf_bin_width) * vaf_bin_width]
vaf_plot_dt[vaf_bin >= 1, vaf_bin := 1]
vaf_plot_dt <- vaf_plot_dt[, .(count = sum(count)), by = .(vaf_bin, method)]
vaf_plot_dt <- dcast(vaf_plot_dt, vaf_bin ~ method, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

if (!"bwa" %in% names(vaf_plot_dt)) {
  vaf_plot_dt[, bwa := 0]
}
if (!"Pangenome" %in% names(vaf_plot_dt)) {
  vaf_plot_dt[, Pangenome := 0]
}

vaf_plot_dt[, overlap := pmin(bwa, Pangenome)]
vaf_plot_dt[, bwa := pmax(bwa - Pangenome, 0)]
vaf_plot_dt[, Pangenome := pmax(Pangenome - overlap, 0)]

vaf_plot_dt <- melt(
  vaf_plot_dt,
  id.vars = "vaf_bin",
  measure.vars = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"),
  variable.name = "component",
  value.name = "count"
)

vaf_plot_dt[, component := factor(component, levels = c("overlap", "bwa", "Pangenome"))]

p_filter <- ggplot(filter_plot_dt, aes(x = filter, y = count/1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors) +
  xlab("FILTER") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("FILTER counts") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

p_filter

p_gq <- ggplot(gq_plot_dt, aes(x = gq_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = gq_bin_width, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors) +
  xlab("GQ (60 = >=60)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("GQ distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = gq_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_gq

p_dp <- ggplot(dp_plot_dt, aes(x = dp_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = dp_bin_width, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors) +
  xlab("DP (120 = >=120)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("DP distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

p_dp

p_dpNormalized <- ggplot(dpNormalized_plot_dt, aes(x = normalized_dp_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = normalized_dp_bin_width, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors) +
  xlab("Normalized DP (4 = >=4)") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("Normalized DP distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = normalized_dp_threshold_lower, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = normalized_dp_threshold_upper, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_dpNormalized

p_vaf <- ggplot(vaf_plot_dt, aes(x = vaf_bin, y = count/1e6, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = vaf_bin_width, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = component_colors) +
  xlab("VAF") +
  ylab("Count (millions)") +
  ggtitle("VAF distribution") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vaf_threshold, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

p_vaf

# save as svg all plots
ggsave("deepvariant_qc_metrics/filter_counts.svg", p_filter, width = 4, height = 4)
ggsave("deepvariant_qc_metrics/gq_distribution.svg", p_gq, width = 4, height = 4)
ggsave("deepvariant_qc_metrics/dp_distribution.svg", p_dp, width = 4, height = 4)
ggsave("deepvariant_qc_metrics/normalized_dp_distribution.svg", p_dpNormalized, width = 4, height = 4)
ggsave("deepvariant_qc_metrics/vaf_distribution.svg", p_vaf, width = 4, height = 4)
```

```{r visualize per-sample summary metrics, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
sample_summary[, sample := factor(sample)]
sample_summary[, method := factor(method, levels = c("bwa", "Pangenome"))]

method_colors <- c(
  "bwa" = "#0072B2",
  "Pangenome" = "#D55E00"
)

sample_summary_plot_dt <- melt(
  sample_summary[, .(
    sample,
    method,
    n_sites,
    median_gq,
    median_dp,
    approx_median_vaf,
    pass_fraction,
    refcall_fraction
  )],
  id.vars = c("sample", "method"),
  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name = "value"
)

sample_summary_plot_dt[, metric := factor(
  metric,
  levels = c(
    "n_sites",
    "median_gq",
    "median_dp",
    "approx_median_vaf",
    "pass_fraction",
    "refcall_fraction"
  )
)]

p_sample_summary <- ggplot(sample_summary_plot_dt, aes(x = method, y = value, group = sample, color = method)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey70", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  xlab("Method") +
  ylab("Value") +
  ggtitle("Per-sample summary metrics") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_sample_summary

```
